title: CISSP Domains (CBK)
description: The eight domains defined by ISC² that make up the CISSP Common Body of Knowledge.

title: Security and Risk Management
description: Covers governance, compliance, legal/regulatory issues, ethics, risk management, and business continuity planning; highest exam weight at ~15%.

title: Asset Security
description: Covers data classification, ownership, privacy, retention, and handling of information assets.

title: Security Architecture and Engineering
description: Covers security models, design principles, cryptography, and physical security.

title: Communication and Network Security
description: Covers network architecture, protocols, secure channels, and network attacks.

title: Identity and Access Management
description: Covers authentication, authorization, access control models, and identity lifecycle management.

title: Security Assessment and Testing
description: Covers audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and log reviews.

title: Security Operations
description: Covers incident management, forensics, disaster recovery, change management, and monitoring.

title: Software Development Security
description: Covers SDLC security, secure coding practices, software testing, and DevSecOps; carries high exam weight alongside Domain 1.
